### GET `/api/ShipStation/GetShipStationIntegration`

### POST `/api/ShipStation/CreateShipStationIntegration`

### POST `/api/ShipStation/DeleteShipStationIntegration`

Used for ShipStation to delete a ShipStation integration by its id

### POST `/api/ShipStation/EditShipStationIntegration`
